nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

Caravaggio chiaroscuro, Kodak 35mm grain, cinematic, live action, Shoot in a ancient temple environment in the middle of a jungle. Light rays coming from the ceiling, particles are visibly floating in the light.


subject_definitions: 
<Subject 1> is the character shown in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the character shown in <Picture 2> (hair style is a long reddish hair pulled into a neat, high updo/bun held by a golden tiara).
<Subject 3> is the character shown in <Picture 3>.
<Subject 4> is the character shown in <Picture 4> (green fur tiger named tiger).


<Subject 2> is Anya Taylor Joy from <Picture 2>.  
<Subject 1> is a young Arnold Schwarzenegger.  

Heman is <Subject 1>.
Tila is <Subject 2>.
Tiamat is <Subject 3>. 
tiger is <Subject 4>.
"our heroes" are  Heman, Tila and the tiger together.

retention_analysis: 
Keep the identity, face, hair, clothing and overall appearance of <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, <Subject 3>, <Subject 4> consistent across every shot. 
<Picture 1> must be used for <Subject 1> face, hair, body, clothing and overall appearance.
<Picture 2> for <Subject 2> face, hair, body, clothing and overall appearance.

Heman is <Subject 1>.
Tila is <Subject 2>.
Tiamat is <Subject 3>. 
tiger is <Subject 4>.
"our heroes" are  Heman, Tila and the tiger together.

detailed_description:
properties.local_prompts:
Cinematic, live-action.
the camera is a side view shot, tracking our heroes: heman (<Subject 1>) and tila (<Subject 3>) are mounted on tiger (<Subject 4>), riding together as tiger runs through in the middle of a jungle as fast as he can. Tila is sitting behind heman on the saddle.
The floor is wild jungle floor, no pavement or man made floor. In a continuous movement, the camera arcs to a shoulder view with small amplitude at slow speed: tiger still running fast, we can see they are getting closer to an ancient maya like pyramid in the middle of the jungle (use <Picture 5> as reference for the pyramid). It's old and the jungle has grown all over the pyramid... its really old.  | camera cuts to a side view, tracking our heroes: They cross from the jungle into a temple room, heman and tila still on  tigers back, and tiger is still running, real fast. Heman pulls the harness, and tiger stops suddenly, roars as he lower his back close to the floor, almost like sitting, and skids trying to stop, very "cartoony" like, with smoke, tracks on the floor, it slides on the floor for a long while before stopping.  | camera cut to a face closeup shot of Tila as she points to the right. Tila (S2) says: <d>[English] I heard something coming from that direction, he-man!</d> 

 | continuing from the last frame of the previous shot, the camera zooms out with small amplitude at slow speed: Heman dismounts the tiger and starts walking to the right. Tila stays mounted and leans forward. | the camera cuts to a frontal closeup of heman: Heman (S1) says: <d>[English] There's a weird and evil dark energy in this place.</d> at the same time the camera starts to Shake Strongly, and the room starts to crumble. While he talks, Heman looks up, a little worried. Heman (S1) says: <d>[English] I don't like this!</d> | cut to a closeup of Tilas face, front camera: Tila make a scared face, close her eyes, cover her head with her hands, protecting herself from the debris. 
The whole room crumbles around her as a big loud dragon roar is heard. Tila (S2) says: <d>[English] What a fuck was that?</d> | cut to wide low shot behind our heroes: We can see the temple room crumbling around then.

there's a huge ancient gate in front of him (about 100 feet high) that is crumbling down, and it's really dark passing the gate, with a dark fog hiding anything that is inside there. Another loud dragon roar sound... a moment pass and a huge red dragon head starts to come out of the fog (Tiamat central head), slowly, followed by the other heads, they   break the gate and walls as they come out... 

The camera zooms out to show Tiamat, all heads drooling in hunger, in all its huge size and glory, showing our tiny heroes at the bottom of the frame. Tiamat red head looks up roars. The other heads starts to move and roar randomly. The red head moves down really close to our heroes, and saliva start to drool as he looks at then... tiamat is hungry and wants to it our heroes. 

Heman (S1) shout: <d>[English] Fuck this! </d> 

Heman just sprints away from the dragon, towards the camera slightly to the left, leaving Tila and tiger confused. Tila and tiger look at each other for a moment, and Tila and Tiger start sprint after Heman while Tila (S2) shouts: <d>[English] Wait for us you jack ass!!</d>
